nodes.label: AI agents as product surface
nodes.rationale: Show agents (Coding Sessions, drafts PRs, triage) doing the work to prove the product is powered by and for agents.

nodes.label: Product-as-hero
nodes.rationale: Embed a realistic product scenario (issue list/agents working), not a mock, so visitors see real work happening and immediately understand the category.

nodes.label: Credibility metrics in hero
nodes.rationale: Put hard numbers in the hero (135+ currencies, 99.999% uptime, US$1.9tn volume) to establish authority before the fold.

nodes.label: Agentic infrastructure positioning
nodes.rationale: Lead with 'Agentic Infrastructure' to target coding agents and AI-era builders, pairing the category headline with live deploy evidence.

nodes.label: Hard credibility metric in hero
nodes.rationale: Add a real number ('Trusted by X city agencies' / '99.99% uptime') in the hero, not the stats row below, mirroring Stripe.

nodes.label: Identity-targeting headline
nodes.rationale: Rewrite headline for a specific persona ('For cities that build for tomorrow') to target identity rather than be generic utility.

nodes.label: Core promise: no complaint disappears
nodes.rationale: The differentiator is transparency — the entire complaint journey is visible from submission to resolution. Agents are the engine, not the story.

nodes.label: The Pipeline hero concept
nodes.rationale: A live ticket flowing through agent stages in real time is UrbanPulse's strongest differentiator; recommended Concept 1 for Hero v2.

nodes.label: Universal hero formula
nodes.rationale: Category headline (3-4 words) + sub-value prop + large real functional product interface + cropped bottom + 1-2 CTAs, with optional real metric and subtle social proof.

nodes.label: Hero v3 three-layer spec
nodes.rationale: Communicate three layers at once: Category (2s), Outcome via one complaint journey (5s), Proof via visible AI agents (10s). Play-once motion, one accent glow, restrained typography.

nodes.label: $0 MVP single-scroll page
nodes.rationale: With a $0/30-day constraint, ship a single-scroll page answering one question per fold, free tooling only, one CTA, excalidraw diagrams, dark editorial palette, WCAG AA, Lighthouse >= 90.

nodes.label: One vs Nine specialists
nodes.rationale: Contrast one generic AI vs nine specialists each owning one decision, so errors are caught (defense in depth). Concept 1 chosen, borrowing Concept 3's error-chain logic.

nodes.label: Linear design SaaS trend
nodes.rationale: Dark mode, bold typography, monochrome, high contrast — popularized by Linear and now standard practice (2025+), with sequential logical content flow.

nodes.label: Restraint equals premium
nodes.rationale: Premium comes from what you DON'T use: aggressive reduction, one font family, color only when it carries meaning, discipline to leave things out.

nodes.label: Hero v2 problem bucketing & spec revision
nodes.norm_label: hero v2 problem bucketing & spec revision

nodes.label: A Tuesday Morning narrative concept
nodes.rationale: Ultra-specific cinematic moment (one resident, one flickering streetlight, 11 days) to make the visitor feel the problem before the solution is revealed. Highest emotional impact; recommended concept.

nodes.label: Information-to-emotion principle
nodes.rationale: Every landing section's primary goal is emotional, not informational. Use before/after contrast, specificity over abstraction, and tension before release.

nodes.label: AI workspace for teams and agents
nodes.rationale: Position as 'AI where your team works' and show the product with an AI chat overlay so the 'thinking together' promise is visible.
nodes.norm_label: ai workspace for teams and agents

nodes.label: AI presentation workspace
nodes.rationale: Prompt-to-presentation with Pitch Agent, brand library, and template consistency so teams win more deals.

nodes.label: Proactive AI assistant everywhere
nodes.rationale: Go is a proactive assistant that offers help without being asked, spanning Mail, Docs, Calendar, and any app.
